title: Claims Payments Rate Rule: Partner Price Hold on Customer-Arranged Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Rentals
content:
**Rate rule.** Under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, the daily amount of a customer-arranged rental is held to the partner price on the claim. The partner price is the rate recorded on the most recently entered partner direct-bill authorization on the claim's rental ledger.

| The claim carries a partner direct-bill authorization | Customer-arranged rental's recorded rate | Daily amount |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Above the partner rate | The partner rate |
| Yes | Not above the partner rate | The customer-arranged rental's recorded rate |
| No | Any | The lower of the recorded rate and the option's daily limit |

## Cases (hypothetical, Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 50/1500, daily limit $50.00)

- A partner authorization is on the claim at $44.00. The customer's own rental is recorded at $52.00. Daily amount: $44.00.
- A partner authorization is on the claim at $44.00. The customer's own rental is recorded at $39.00. Daily amount: $39.00.
- A partner authorization is on the claim at $44.00. The customer's own rental is recorded at $44.00, which is not above the partner rate. Daily amount: $44.00.
- No partner authorization is on the claim. The customer's own rental is recorded at $52.00. Daily amount: $50.00.
- Two partner authorizations are on the claim, entered at $41.00 and later at $46.00. The partner price is $46.00, the rate on the most recently entered one.
